caption_L1: This bar plot is called Percentage of millennials in the U.S. who had been told by a health care provider that they had select health conditions as of 2018. Response is measured with a categorical scale starting with ADD/ADHD and ending with Overweight on the x-axis. Percentage of millennials is drawn using a scale of range 0.00 to 0.15 along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Of the recorded health conditions, Depression is by far the most prevalent among those diagnosed in millennials in the US, as of 2018. Anxiety, overweightness and migraines are also fairly prevalent.
